I am only 10 years old, so I help my father on our small millet plot here in the North West. We do not have much money for fertilizer, but my father sometimes buys a little urea when the subsidy comes, and we spread the droppings from our goats and chickens on the field before the rains. We plant the millet seed we saved from last harvest, together with cowpea between the rows, and we weed by hand with my brothers because hiring people is too costly for such a small plot.
